Metrics platform: daily challenge, 2027-02-24

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-24: Metrics platform. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Thousands of services send a stream of measurements: CPU, errors, latency. You store them, draw the dashboards and fire the alerts. The platform watching everyone else must never go down first, and one customer creating millions of new series can ruin the bill.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
